label: Build a model from a fixture and solve it once
notes: TEST EXAMPLE - edit before running. solve_policy ALLOW_ONE authorises exactly one fresh solver run, and the plan reports PLANNED_SOLVE_COUNT / MAX_AUTHORIZED_SOLVES before anything happens. 'fixture_definition' is your own fixture JSON: an object whose 'command_blocks' map history-block names to verbatim CST history text. The public repository ships no fixture files, so write one from your own model (see docs/TASKSPEC.md section 5.2). Point 'project_path' at a scratch directory outside this repository: this task creates that project. 'max_solves' is only allowed with solve_policy ALLOW_UP_TO_N, which is why this example does not declare it.
